outcome: Surgeon's satisfaction with diagnostic information from MR defecography reports
Usefulness of MR defecography in surgical decision-making and management strategies
cohort: A consecutive series of 218 patients (mean age 60 +/- 11; 193 females and 25 males) with clinical suspicion of pelvic disorders who underwent MR defecography at a single university hospital.
finding: MR defecography provided good or excellent diagnostic information in 70% of patients and added clinical value in the preoperative surgical setting for 86% of patients who underwent surgery.
cross-section timing: Data collected from January 2021 to June 2024
